title: Exercise Northstar: D-Day
description: The exercise is live. But field commanders are reporting stale information on their screens. Units moved 20 minutes ago but the screen still shows them at their old positions. Decisions are being made on outdated intel.
storyContext: Exercise is live, 3,000 in the field. Then the radio crackles: "Command, why does my screen show Alpha Company at their old position? They moved to the ridge 20 minutes ago." Commanders are making decisions on stale information. In a real operation, that gets people hurt.

software-engineer.title: Track Down the Stale Data
software-engineer.instruction: Commanders are seeing 20-minute-old positions. Trace where in the chain the data is getting stuck. Arrange the investigation steps.
software-engineer.hint: Data can get stuck anywhere — at the source, in transit, in storage, or on the screen. Trace the path step by step from start to end.

items.label: Confirm field devices are actually sending fresh updates
Check if updates are piling up somewhere between field and command
Check if the system is showing old saved answers instead of fresh ones
Verify the live connection is actually pushing updates to screens
Deploy the fix and confirm fresh data flows to commander screens

data-scientist.title: Help Commanders Decide Now
data-scientist.instruction: While engineers fix the data problem, commanders still need to make decisions with 20-minute-old positions. How do you give them a usable picture right now?
data-scientist.hint: Think about what commanders need most: a confident guess, trusted manual reports, honest uncertainty markers, or a completely different source of truth?

options.label: Use each unit's last known speed and direction to estimate where they probably are now. Surprisingly accurate for short time gaps.
Have each unit call in their position by radio every 5 minutes. Old school but 100% accurate.
Show old positions but add a growing ring around each dot so commanders see how outdated the info is. Honest, but might cause decision paralysis.
Show live drone camera feeds so commanders can literally see where units are. Works perfectly unless clouds roll in.

cloud-engineer.title: Rebuild the Data Pipeline
cloud-engineer.instruction: Updates are getting stuck between field and screen. Redesign the route. Stage 1: data arrives. Stages 2 and 3: processing. Stage 4: delivered to screens.
cloud-engineer.hint: Follow the natural flow — data arrives, gets sorted, gets cleaned, then gets pushed out to whoever needs it.

items.label: Field Receiver — collects all incoming data from field devices
Live Sorter — processes and organises incoming updates
Old Data Cleaner — marks stale data so fresh data replaces it
Live Relay — pushes fresh data to commander screens
Failed Message Store — holds undelivered updates for retry
System Watcher — alerts the team if any stage stops working
